name.value: Old Xian's Food Noodle & Mart 老西安面馆

description.value: Old Xian's Food is a Xi'an-style Chinese restaurant on Vancouver's Cambie Street specialising in hand-pulled belt noodles and traditional dishes such as oil-splashed noodles and roujiamo meat buns. The Cambie location sits directly across from King Edward SkyTrain station and pairs a full-service restaurant with an in-house food mart stocking grab-and-go bowls, bento boxes, sauces, and snacks. The chain has received coverage in Tricity News and Noms Magazine for bringing authentic Northwestern Chinese cuisine to Metro Vancouver.
